key_insight: Depth Pro 2 aims to deliver sharp depth boundaries without sacrificing stability across video frames. A single network estimates metric depth from both images and video at native resolution.
problem_solved: Monocular depth methods commonly trade off crisp object boundaries against temporal consistency: single-frame methods favor sharpness, while multi-frame methods favor stability.
method: Train one scalable network to process both individual images and video.
Predict dense metric depth maps at native resolution.
Target boundary sharpness and temporal consistency within the same approach.
impact: The approach could simplify depth-estimation pipelines that need both detailed image predictions and stable video output. Metric depth estimates physical distances rather than only relative scene ordering.
visual_elements: Trade-off diagram contrasting single-frame sharpness with multi-frame temporal stability.
Pipeline showing image and video inputs entering one network and producing metric depth maps.
Object-edge close-up illustrating the importance of sharp depth boundaries.
Video-frame strip illustrating consistent depth predictions over time.
paper_title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
paper_authors: Peiyun Hu, Marko Mihajlovic, Lyndon Duong, Lahav Lipson, Wei Dong
